content:
emma: incident-bot: High error rate on /v1/generate in prod-us-east (canary traffic).
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for p99 latency and 502 responses.
liam: seeing a burst of CrashLoopBackOff + ImagePullBackOff on inference-canary-2.
emma: can someone check kubectl in the canary node pool?
sanjay: running `kubectl get pods -n prod -o wide | grep inference-canary` — several show `ImagePullBackOff`.
liam: logs show `pull access denied` from our registry for image `redwood/inference:canary-20250315`.
ops-bot: deploy bot: deployment redwood-inference/canary rolled at 2025-03-15T09:12Z by ci-pipeline.
emma: @sanjay any recent credential/registry rotate?
sanjay: yes, creds were rotated this morning for the private registry but the deploy job didn't refresh imagePullSecrets.
liam: root cause = stale imagePullSecret in the canary deployment, combined with a node drain earlier that restarted pods.
emma: impact: ~15% of canary capacity failing, traffic split is 10% canary -> customers see increased 502s but majority routed to stable.
sanjay: mitigation plan: 1) flip canary traffic to 0% 2) add quick fix to deployment with correct imagePullSecrets 3) restart canary deploy / roll forward 4) postmortem.
liam: switching traffic now (console): `redwood roll traffic --service inference --from canary --to stable --percent 100` => initiated :hourglass_flowing_sand:
oncall-bot: traffic switch confirmed, canary receiving 0%.
emma: applying fix: patching deployment with updated imagePullSecrets and restarting.
sanjay: `kubectl patch deployment/inference-canary -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"imagePullSecrets":[{"name":"reg-secret-latest"}]}}}}'`
liam: patched, new pods starting, `kubectl get pods` show `Running` now.
emma: monitoring - error rate back to baseline within 3 minutes :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident severity: SEV3; duration ~28m; no major customer impact (>1% errors briefly).
sanjay: leaving a canary hold until CI deploy pipeline refreshes imagePullSecrets automation.
liam: oncall handoff: I'm taking the post-incident follow-up, leaving a note in incident tracker.
emma: thanks — escalate to infra-sre if the registry rotation automation needs a formal rollback.
oncall-bot: handoff: emma -> liam (sre-rotation) at 1746001190.
